evidence: The body initializes a 16-bit local output to zero and calls address-only f_70008bbc30 with the second input, that output pointer, and 1. When it returns true, the function reads a 32-bit value at second_input+0x26, masks to six bits, and if it equals 0x1d calls f_7000860a30 and stores its result byte at first_input+0x24c. It then copies the local output value to first_input+0x256 (byte) and +0x25c (32-bit) and calls the accepted aggregate_related_attribute_values helper with first_input. decompiled/main/main_0111.c:12024-12042. No indexed caller is available; roles of the address-only helpers and fields are unresolved.

The body first calls accepted attribute_context_status_is_2_or_3 and returns zero when it is true. Otherwise it resolves a pointer using global slot 0x700227e000+0x6c0 and key 0xd06, follows the pointer, or calls f_70018450e8 when null. It reads a 32-bit value at resolved_pointer+0x70, masks to 9 bits, and when the result is at most 0x5e calls f_700185c230, takes the returned low byte, then calls f_7001824c18 with selector 0x1c and that byte. It always returns zero. decompiled/main/main_0033.c:50253-50280. No indexed caller is available; address-only helper semantics remain unknown.

Reads a 32-bit value at input+0x104. For values at least 1, calls address-only f_7000a96738 with that value and returns zero. For signed values below 1, it proceeds only when adding 1 wraps to zero (value -1), then calls f_70008e0510 and f_70008cfb64; if the latter returns nonzero, it calls the accepted process_player_card_hit_zone helper with zeroed x1-x3. Other paths return zero. decompiled/main/main_0078.c:29561-29580. No indexed caller is available; meanings of the other helpers and field are unresolved.

Loads a provider pointer by resolving global address 0x7004650000+0x998 through f_700181a6bc and following offset +0x30; if nonnull, calls accepted nested_attribute_provider_get_float with selector 0x1b. If the pointer is null, it obtains a fallback through f_700183f6e4 and reads the same selector. Both paths return 1 exactly when the returned float is greater than zero, else 0. decompiled/main/main_0024.c:17337-17355. No indexed caller is available.

Zeroes the 32-bit value at input+0, then calls accepted return_one_or_evaluate_attribute_context_status_conditions. If that predicate returns true, it exits with the value still zero. Otherwise it calls f_70000aa3f0, examines the low byte of its result, and writes 1 at input+0 only when the low byte equals 2. decompiled/main/main_0125.c:3833-3842. No indexed caller is available; the second helper is unresolved.
